test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 31 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Fill in the blank with most appropriate tense:

By next month, she ___ in this company for five years.
solution:
The correct answer is '**4**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence refers to an action that will have been completed by a specific point in the future ("by next month"), which requires the use of the future perfect continuous tense.
 
• The correct structure for the future perfect continuous tense is **"will have been + present participle (verb + ing)".**
 
• **Option 4: "will have been worked"** is the correct choice as it follows this structure and matches the context of the sentence.
 
• Options 1, 2, and 3 are incorrect because they do not use the appropriate future perfect continuous tense.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"By next month, she **will have been worked**__ in this company for five years."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "work"** is incorrect because it is in the present tense and does not match the future perfect continuous tense required by the sentence.
 
• **Option 2: "worked"** is incorrect as it represents past tense and does not indicate the future perfect continuous action.
 
• **Option 3: "will have work"** is incorrect as it does not use the correct form of the verb (missing "been" and "ing").
